original_specification.description: Gray felt mat is a conceptual setting for desktop devices. It combines the specified surroundings with independently managed lighting.

original_specification.scale_policy: Mat extent from 0.2 to 1.5 m; physically scaled fibers; preserve subject dimensions; fit the stage once to an explicit selection, never continuously rescale the CAD model

validation: Keep grain, joints and pores at physical scale.
